summary: Customer reported missing order (ID not provided) and sought running shoes under 90 units budget. Companion presented three options: Footwear 01 (50.86), Footwear 41 (61.89, discounted), and Footwear 23 (100.29). verbatim.text: My order never showed up and I am really disappointed. Anyway, I need a new pair of running shoes.
